recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: sequel sand-worlds resurfacing under improbable old names
quiet tug-of-war over who owns the invisible on-screen caret
summer internships framed as handwritten, deliberately unplugged seasons
marine-layer fog sponging skylines into soft gray drafts
may light winning slowly against a stubborn coastal chill

composer-2-fast.concept: You are a dew bead crawling down steamed glass—tap neighbors to fuse into bigger droplets before the pane warms and flash-evaporates your chain; the fog outside pulses like a muted kick drum.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Tap-merge chain building on a grid of droplets racing an invisible heat sweep.
composer-2-fast.touch_control: Tap adjacent cells to fuse; occasional long-press to brace against a gust.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: Thirty seconds of escalating combo sizes with a tactile pop on each fusion.
composer-2-fast.escalation: Heat fronts sweep faster across the glass while wind shears scramble likely merge paths.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: Macro photo glass, monochrome fog gradients, microscopic water beads catching stray neon.

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Three ghost trains tinted like dream-pop album art swap elevated tracks—you flick gates open only during bass drops timed to faint platform ripples emerging from fog.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: Lane-switch + beat-gating: swipe to reroute trains through openings that blink on the downbeat.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: Swipe left/right between stacked rails; tap to slam a crossing barrier on perfect timing.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Each clean crossing layers harmony stabs; a near-miss still rewards with a shimmering ghost trail.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Tracks multiply, phantom decoy trains appear, tempos jitter like stutter-house fills.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: Pastel noir, vapor-light bloom, elongated shadows over wet concrete.

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: A shelf of mis-sorted crates labeled only by vibes—physics-flick crates into docks that subtly reject wrong fits; decipher the day's hidden taxonomy from color hum and haptic thunk.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: Sorting with weighted tosses: angle and swipe strength decide landing; wrong piles bounce crates back.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: Angled swipe-toss from a anchored thumb zone.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: Satisfying clunk plus brief chromatic sting when the correct dock accepts a crate.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Genre tags vanish mid-round, docks rotate, crates gain sticky couplings needing double-taps.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: Paper cutout warehouse, gouache grime, handwritten Swedish color names as flavor only.

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: One cramped screen of fogged nodes—tracing a luminous path rewinds tiny commit-like knots that block escape; lasers labeled as overzealous 'pointer assist' skim if you linger.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Short path drawing constrained to snapping nodes combined with rhythmic tap dodges.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: Drag-draw between nodes then release to commit the path; tap to sidestep skim beams.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Clearing a knot unfogs a vignette revealing the next miniature puzzle cliff in under a minute.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Mandatory nodes proliferate and beams widen into sawtooth patrols synced to rising BPM.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: Neon-on-charcoal schematic, terminal fog, holographic breadcrumbs.
